name: aoe2mc.battle_royale.start
text: Battle Royale: the Corruption takes the map from its border to its centre in %s. It destroys all units and buildings in it.

name: aoe2mc.bot.cannot_build
text: I cannot build a %s there now.

name: aoe2mc.bot.cannot_train
text: I cannot train that unit: I have no building for it.

name: aoe2mc.bot.flare_two
text: Flare two places for the wall.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_market
text: I have no market: I cannot send tribute.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_wall_resources
text: I have not enough resources for a wall.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_water
text: I have no water near my town: I cannot build a navy.

name: aoe2mc.build.flat
text: The %s must stand on flat ground.

name: aoe2mc.build.gate_spot
text: A %s must go on 4 tiles of an own wall in a straight line, or on 3 diagonal tiles.

name: aoe2mc.build.shore
text: A %s must stand on water next to the shore.

name: aoe2mc.build.tiles_cost
text: Not enough resources: %s tiles of %s cost %s.

name: aoe2mc.build.wall_end
text: %s: right click the end of the wall.

name: aoe2mc.build.water
text: A %s must stand on the water.

name: aoe2mc.camera.fov
text: The fast camera makes the held item swing. To keep it still, set Options > Accessibility Settings > View Bobbing to OFF. The camera also makes the view wider, which shows more of the map. To keep the normal view, set Options > Accessibility Settings > FOV Effects to 0 %.

name: aoe2mc.camera.on
text: Camera: on, speed x%s. Shift right click: next speed.

name: aoe2mc.challenge.battle-formations
text: Defeat all enemy units and lose few units

name: aoe2mc.challenge.booming
text: Train 100 villagers and advance to the Imperial Age

name: aoe2mc.challenge.defending-against-a-rush
text: Advance to the Castle Age and survive the enemy attacks

name: aoe2mc.challenge.early-economy
text: Gather 200 food, 200 wood, 100 gold and 200 stone, train 21 villagers, build a lumber camp and a mill, and advance to the Feudal Age

name: aoe2mc.challenge.fast-castle-age
text: Train 27 villagers, build 5 houses and advance to the Castle Age

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_bronze
text: %s units lost, bronze medal up to %s

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_gold
text: %s units lost, gold medal up to %s

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_silver
text: %s units lost, silver medal up to %s

name: aoe2mc.cheat.sharing
text: Sharing is caring: your income goes to your allies

name: aoe2mc.conquest.allies_end
text: Only allies are left: the alliances end. The last player alive wins.

name: aoe2mc.controls.attack
text: Attack: select military units, then right click an enemy.

name: aoe2mc.controls.build
text: Build: select villagers, right click them for the build menu, select a building, then left click the ground. Shift + left click: place more. Right click: cancel.

name: aoe2mc.controls.camera
text: Camera: right click with the spyglass Camera (hotbar key 2): you walk fast high above the map. Shift right click: the next speed. Right click again: you fly down.

name: aoe2mc.controls.garrison
text: Garrison: select units, then right click your own building. Its menu lets them out. Town centre menu: Ring Town Bell.

name: aoe2mc.controls.gather
text: Gather: select villagers, then right click a tree, a fruit bush, a mine or a farm.

name: aoe2mc.controls.goto
text: Go to: right click with the compass Go to (hotbar key 3): a menu of your town centres, your control groups and the next idle villager.

name: aoe2mc.controls.groups
text: Control groups: select units, take a group item (hotbar keys 5 to 9) and Shift + right click to save the selection. Right click: select the group.

name: aoe2mc.controls.head
text: Controls (hold the carrot on a stick; the action bar shows the next step):

name: aoe2mc.controls.menu
text: Game menu: right click with the book Game menu (hotbar key 4): diplomacy and tribute, flare, save, pause and the tech tree.

name: aoe2mc.controls.move
text: Move: with a selection, right click the ground.

name: aoe2mc.controls.research
text: Research and age up: right click your own building and click a technology or the next age in its menu.

name: aoe2mc.controls.select
text: Select: left click a unit. Hold left click and look across the ground: a selection box. Right click: give orders.

name: aoe2mc.controls.train
text: Train: right click your own building (town centre, barracks ...) and click a unit in its menu.

name: aoe2mc.diplomacy.changed
text: Player %s changed its stance to you: %s.

name: aoe2mc.diplomacy.speed
text: Player %s set the game speed to %s.

name: aoe2mc.follow.refuse_guard
text: Guard: click an own unit or building

name: aoe2mc.garrison.bell_seek
text: The town bell rings: %s villagers seek shelter

name: aoe2mc.gather.corner
text: Selection box: click the other corner

name: aoe2mc.hints.attack_ground
text: Attack Ground: right click the ground

name: aoe2mc.hints.attack_move
text: Attack Move: right click the ground

name: aoe2mc.hints.building
text: Place the %s: right click the ground · Shift + right click: place more · Cancel: /trigger aoe_build set 0

name: aoe2mc.hints.building_paper
text: %s: left click to place · Shift: place more · Right click: cancel

name: aoe2mc.hints.corner
text: Selection box: right click the other corner

name: aoe2mc.hints.follow
text: Follow: right click an own or allied unit

name: aoe2mc.hints.guard
text: Guard: right click an own or allied unit or building

name: aoe2mc.hints.military
text: %s · Right click: attack an enemy, stance menu · %s

name: aoe2mc.hints.none
text: Left click: select a unit · Hold left click: selection box

name: aoe2mc.hints.none_wand
text: Right click: select a unit · Wand: selection box

name: aoe2mc.hints.villagers
text: %s · Right click: gather, build, build menu · %s

name: aoe2mc.recap.next
text: The game is over. Right click the Recap book in your hand to see the results. Stop the game program with Ctrl-C in its console.

name: aoe2mc.repair.no_resources
text: Not enough resources to repair the %s.

name: aoe2mc.replay.hill_won
text: %s held the monument: King of the Hill victory at %s.

name: aoe2mc.replay.join_help
text: Double-tap Shift: spectator view (fly through blocks). Right click the hotbar items: replay control.

name: aoe2mc.replay.king_died
text: : the King died at %s. Regicide: the player is out.

name: aoe2mc.replay.live_jump
text: Live replay: the jump stops at the delay behind the game.

name: aoe2mc.replay.no_camera
text: This record has no camera of its player.

name: aoe2mc.replay.relic_won
text: takes the relic to a monastery and wins.

name: aoe2mc.replay.restart_jump
text: The server restarts for the jump back: join it again.

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_economy
text: : villagers trained %s, gathered %s, idle villager time %s, idle TC time %s

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_hill_holds
text: : holds the monument (King of the Hill)

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_military
text: : military units trained %s, units lost %s, buildings lost %s, APM %s%s

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_relic
text: : wins, relic in a monastery %s (Capture the Relic)

name: aoe2mc.replay.town_fell
text: : the town centre fell at %s. Sudden Death: the player is out.

name: aoe2mc.replay_input.help
text: Replay: right click the items in your hotbar, or click:

name: aoe2mc.run.chat_hint
text: Chat: a normal line goes to all, /tm TEXT to your allies, /msg NAME TEXT to one person.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first
text: First step: hold the command stick and right click one of your villagers.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first_paper
text: First step: hold the command stick and left click one of your villagers.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_goal
text: Goal: win the game. Victory setting: %s.

name: aoe2mc.stance.no_ground
text: No unit can attack the ground

name: aoe2mc.train.rally
text: Right click the ground for the rally point.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.ended
text: The treaty ended: players can attack now.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.refuse_endless
text: Treaty: you cannot attack in this game.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start
text: Treaty: no player can attack another player before %s.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start_endless
text: Treaty: no player can attack another player in this game.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.barracks
text: Build a barracks: right click on a selected villager, choose the barracks and place it. The action bar above the hotbar tells you where to place it.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camera
text: Move fast over the map: right click with the "Camera" item, walk, then right click with it again.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camp
text: Destroy the enemy camp in the middle of the map: select your Militia and right click on a building. The boss bar at the top shows the step.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camps
text: Build a lumber camp near the trees and a mill near the berries. The sidebar on the right shows the wood they cost.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.complete
text: The tutorial is complete. Next: play a game against the bot: python3 game/run.py OUTWorld --play --bot

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.feudal
text: Advance to the Feudal Age: right click on your town centre and choose the Feudal Age. The sidebar on the right shows your food.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.food
text: Gather 100 food: send a villager to the berries. The sidebar on the right shows your food.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.house
text: Build a house: right click on a selected villager, choose the house and place it. The action bar above the hotbar tells you where to place it.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.militia
text: Train 3 Militia: right click on your barracks and choose the militia. The sidebar on the right shows your food and gold.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.raid
text: The enemy attacks your villagers! Click the red alert line in the chat to go there, then select your Militia and right click on the enemies. The boss bar at the top shows the health of the selected unit.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.select
text: Select a villager: left click on one of your villagers with the command stick. The boss bar at the top shows the selected unit, the action bar above the hotbar shows the next action.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_barracks
text: TIP: the barracks trains infantry. Infantry is cheap and good against buildings.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camp
text: TIP: attack with all your units together. A small group dies before it can do damage.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camps
text: TIP: build the drop-off buildings near the resources, so that the villagers walk a short way.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_feudal
text: TIP: the next age unlocks new buildings, units and technologies. Keep the villagers at work while you advance.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_food
text: TIP: berries near a mill are a safe start of food. Later, farms give food that does not end.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_house
text: TIP: a house gives room for 5 more population. Look at the population in the sidebar and build houses before it is full.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_militia
text: TIP: you can queue up to 15 units in a building when you have the resources.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_raid
text: TIP: in AoE2 the town bell sends the villagers into the town centre. Ring it when the enemy raids your town.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_select
text: TIP: the Idle line of the sidebar on the right counts your villagers with no work. Give them work.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_villager
text: TIP: train villagers all the time in the first ages. More villagers give more resources.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_wood
text: TIP: villagers gather faster near a drop-off building. Build a lumber camp next to the trees.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.villager
text: Train a villager: right click on your town centre and choose the villager. The sidebar on the right shows the food it costs.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.wood
text: Gather 50 wood: select a villager and right click on a tree. The sidebar on the right shows your wood.

name: aoe2mc.wonder.destroyed
text: The wonder of player %s is destroyed.
